reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001105 (the melody read from 001105a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 15); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. N. B. Herrell's dates (1877–1953) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Herrell_NB (Herrell, N. B. (Noah Benjamin), 1877-1953; 'Died: May 10, 1953, Pasadena, California'; a Nazarene archive gives his birth as 1879; his tunes include THE UNVEILED CHRIST, 'Once our blessed Christ of beauty'). He died in 1953, before 1955; CCEH's page gives only the year 1916. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001105a.nwc).
